hook: 4 marks of a logo that will outlive the trend cycle.
direction: Simple at small sizes, works in one color, distinct in your space, not chasing fads. This audience respects things built to last — cathedrals, not pop-ups. Graphic: timeless vs. trendy comparison (AI-generated abstract examples, no real trademarks).

facebook.text:
4 marks of a logo that will outlive the trend cycle.

1. It reads clearly at small sizes — a favicon, a business card, a shirt pocket.
2. It works in one color. If it falls apart without gradients or effects, it isn't finished.
3. It's distinct in your specific space. Not just "clean" — recognizable among your actual competitors.
4. It isn't chasing what's fashionable right now.

Cathedrals weren't built to be current. They were built to stand. Your logo should work the same way.
